collection.title: Rover 800 1986 to 1991 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following blades for the Rover 800 Mk1 1986 to 1991 will fit, this model requires a 19" wiper blade on both the drivers side and the passengers side. This model uses the Standard Hook arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm, there is also the option of upgrading to the newer Retrofit style wiper blade. We also offer a rear screen wiper for this Rover 800 which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below.
